senses.gloss:
मे मे, i. 1, Ātm. To barter or to exchange.
 --Caus. मापय, To cross over, MBh. 1, 5842 (anomal. ptcple. pres. Ātm. मापयान).
 --With the prep. नि नि, To barter, Man. 10, 94.
 --Cf. Goth. maithms; A.S. madhm; Goth. maidjan, ga-mains; A.S. maene, mán, gemaene; Lat. mūtuus, communis, munus; μοῖτος, ἀμείϐω (Caus. for ἀ-μεϐίω).
